data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mazarah' meaning 'refuge' or 'sanctuary'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance in Islam, reminding us of Allah's protection and refuge in times of need. The name Mazrah carries the meaning “A place of refuge, sanctuary” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mazrah usually hope their child will grow to embody a place of refuge, sanctuary and live with faith, good character and purpose.
